why_not_applied: shared_contracts/message_arity.py is a RECORD, not a claim. It is the exact module Route D imported during attempt 3. Editing it here would make this bundle misrepresent what was in force during a run it is evidence for. The fix belongs in the successor working tree, applied under the operator's arity-repair ratification decision (SUPERVISOR_RETURN.json -> OPEN_ITEMS_FOR_THE_SUPERVISOR -> ARITY_REPAIR_RATIFICATION), not by rewriting published evidence.

defect.statement: In the output-contract-in-force branch, reconcile() returns len(kept) - 1 as narration_preface_count. That is the count of all NON-selected messages, not the count of messages PRECEDING the selected one. When the schema-conforming item is not last, suffix narration is mislabelled as a prefix.
defect.affects: Receipt metadata only. Selection of the conforming message, the Ambiguous conditions, and each route's failure taxonomy are all unaffected.

reproduction.method: A COPY of the published module was imported in a scratchpad with python3 -B and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. The published file was not imported and no __pycache__ was created anywhere in this tree.

blast_radius_in_this_bundle.verdict: ZERO. No committed receipt carries a wrong narration_preface_count.
reasoning: Attempt 3 (the only run in which the repaired module was live for all six turns) emitted zero narration -- every turn had exactly one agent_message, so kept == 1 and len(kept)-1 == 0, which is correct.

Attempt 1 turn 3 -- the only real two-message turn ever observed -- had the shape [prose preface, conforming JSON], i.e. the conforming item LAST. For that shape len(kept)-1 is correct, and it is the case the regression fixture covers. It also predates the repair and wrote no receipt.
Therefore the defect is latent: it has never been reached by observed data.

fix_for_the_successor.change: Track the index of the single conforming item and return the number of kept messages that precede it.
fix_for_the_successor.sketch: for i, text in enumerate(kept): ... collect (i, text) in conforming ... ; idx, chosen = conforming[0]; return chosen, len(kept), idx
fix_for_the_successor.also: Consider reporting narration_suffix_count alongside it, so ordering evidence is complete rather than merely correct.
fix_for_the_successor.contract_impact: shared_contracts/W01_ARITY_RECONCILIATION_CONTRACT.json documents reconcile()'s return tuple and must be amended in the same change.
fix_for_the_successor.parity_note: Route A and Route D import this ONE module by absolute path, so a single corrected module keeps parity by construction. Do not fork or locally re-implement it.
